release_notes.zh-CN:
AskAll 齐问 1.0.2：多端产物随发布上线，桌面端体验升级。

新增：
- 发布流水线：Chrome / Firefox 扩展与 macOS / Windows 桌面端等多端产物统一作为本次发布的产物，上传后自动校验完整性
- 桌面端聊天单元格支持外链打开，在系统浏览器访问对应 AI 会话

优化：
- 新增网页内浮层面板（PageWorkspace），聊天内容内嵌展示
- 重构 ChatView，简化 AI 处理流程，优化时间线滚动行为
- AI 自动化方案升级：弃用旧 autoSend，改用新的自动化引擎，适配各 AI 站点输入方式与选择器的变化
- 改进工作台布局，简化设置页状态管理

修复：
- 修复部分 AI 站点输入与发送适配问题
release_notes.en:
AskAll 1.0.2: multi-platform artifacts now ship with the release, plus desktop experience upgrades.

New:
- Release pipeline: Chrome / Firefox extensions and macOS / Windows desktop installers are bundled together as the artifacts of this release, with upload integrity verification
- Desktop chat cells can open the matching AI conversation in the system browser

Improvements:
- New in-page floating panel (PageWorkspace) with embedded chat content
- Refactored ChatView to simplify AI handling and improve timeline scrolling
- AI automation upgraded: legacy autoSend replaced by a new automation engine that adapts to each AI site's input fields and selectors
- Improved workspace layout and streamlined settings state management

Fixes:
- Fixed several AI site input and send adaptation issues
